{{Top}}
[[File:Apprentice_Robe.jpg|thumb|A [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi Apprentice]] wearing a robe]]
'''Robes''' were loose-fitting outer [[Clothing/Legends|garments]]. They covered most of the wearer's body.

[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] both often wore robes. [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] wore [[Color/Legends|red]] ceremonial robes during the [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]] festivities. [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] wore hand-woven robes with a cowl that covered their entire bodies.<ref name="SWE Jawas">{{SWE|groups|jawas|Jawas}}</ref>

{{Clothes-stub}}
